messages.text: Hey - it's been a few days since my appointment. When does my medication ship?
Thanks for checking in. I can see your recent visit is still being reviewed. Your care team will be in touch with next steps.
Reviewed? The nurse said I'd hear back in a couple of days. Am I being charged for this?
Hi Devon, you have not been charged - billing only starts once treatment is approved and you activate. I'm sorry for the confusion.
So I'm not approved? Nobody has actually told me that. What am I supposed to do now?
